instruction: A candid documentary wide shot of an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet. On the left, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on one leg, kicking her other leg high towards the right. On the right, the man in the black polo and blue shorts (R1) stands facing her, bracing as her foot makes contact with his thigh. The scene is illuminated by bright overhead studio lights, casting soft shadows on the red floor.
elements: R2 kicks one leg high so that her foot contacts R1's thigh
R1 braces and receives the contact on his thigh from R2's foot
R2 balances on one leg while delivering the kick toward R1
R1 faces R2 as the recipient of the kick rather than the kicker
the interaction takes place in an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet

questions.element: R2 delivers the kick to R1's thigh

questions.element: R1 braces as the recipient of R2's kick

questions.q: Is R2 the active striker with her leg extended toward R1, while R1 is the stationary receiver facing her?
questions.element: R2 is the active kicker and R1 is the receiver
